FLASH
South Georgia, South Atlantic
13th October 1985 0600 Local
Officer Commanding, HMS Invincible
From Northwood
Soviet Fleet attempting breakout. Engage and neutralise.
Submarine and air assets availible.
Objectives:
OBJ ALPHA DEFEND Loss of both carriers unacceptable.
OBJ BETA NEUTRALISE Use any and all assets to sink key Soviet units. One Kirvo class, one Slava class, and one Kiev class identified via satellite.
For the Service
